program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let ((blues (find-color g 1)))
           (let ((r1 (fst (nth blues 0)))
                 (c1 (snd (nth blues 0)))
                 (r2 (fst (nth blues 1)))
                 (c2 (snd (nth blues 1))))
             (let ((mr (floor (/ (+ r1 r2) 2)))
                   (mc (floor (/ (+ c1 c2) 2))))
               (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell g mr mc 3)
                                                       (- mr 1)
                                                       mc
                                                       3)
                                             (+ mr 1)
                                             mc
                                             3)
                                   mr
                                   (- mc 1)
                                   3)
                         mr
                         (+ mc 1)
                         3))))))
